name: capell-app/translation-manager
description: Translate interface wording in your language files from the admin, with missing and out-of-date entries flagged and CSV, PO and XLIFF export.

healthChecks.label: Translation Manager diagnostics verify the admin surface, service bindings, and safe filesystem configuration.

marketplace.summary: Compare language files side by side, fill gaps, create languages and exchange CSV, PO and XLIFF files with outside translators.
marketplace.description: Find and fill gaps in the interface wording of Capell, your theme and installed packages. See each language's missing, out-of-date and changed entries beside the original, edit and save them, and check whether a language is ready. Create or duplicate a language, and hand work to translators as CSV, PO or XLIFF.
marketplace.problem: Nobody can see which interface wording is missing or out of date in a language.
marketplace.outcome: Missing and out-of-date wording is flagged and edited in one admin page.

faq.question: Who can use Translation Manager?
faq.answer: Viewing and managing are separate permissions. Anyone with the view permission can open the page, and saving, importing, creating languages and AI drafts need the manage permission.

faq.question: Where do my edits end up?
faq.answer: In your site's language files, so the server needs a language folder it can write to and that survives site updates. Wording from packages is saved as your own copy, so package updates don't overwrite it.

faq.question: Does it translate page content?
faq.answer: No. Page content isn't handled here, so translate it on the language tabs of each page. This page covers button labels, form messages and menu text from the system, your theme and installed packages.

faq.question: Can it draft translations with AI?
faq.answer: Yes, once AI Orchestrator is installed and enabled, an API key is added for the AI provider and calls from the admin are allowed. You accept or reject each suggestion before you save.

faq.question: Can I send files to an outside translator?
faq.answer: Yes. Export CSV, PO or XLIFF files from the tools panel, then import the translated file back. Saving checks that placeholders, plural forms and any glossary terms still match the original.
